answer.reason: The verses state Abijam's battle victory over Jeroboam and Israel and his capture of cities, beyond what the summary gives.

clauses.english: defeated Jeroboam and Israel in battle, when God smote them before Judah
clauses.quote: God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah

clauses.english: took the cities of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephraim from Jeroboam
clauses.quote: took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof

doubts: The verses call him Abijah in 2 Chronicles and Abia in 1 Chronicles and Matthew; taken as the same king of Judah, son of Rehoboam and father of Asa.
2CH 13:2 gives his mother as Michaiah daughter of Uriel, unlike 1KI 15:2 and 2CH 11:20; left out of the line.
1KI 15:3 says he walked in his father's sins; omitted as a judgment, not an event.
